title: OPNsense Syslog Bytes Matched Leaderboard
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=opnsense:syslog bytes=*
| stats sum(bytes) as total_value, avg(bytes) as avg_value by rule_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks rule values by total and average bytes matched across OPNsense syslog events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `bytes` values for each OPNsense syslog event and review total and average bytes matched by rule.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total bytes matched.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly keeps which rule shows the biggest bytes matched numbers in your OPNsense syslog data.
